svg.title: Coach 6, the second evening, half past eight
svg.desc: A train coach in the evening with eleven passengers sitting in four groups and one person alone, bags in the racks and a coat laid over somebody asleep.

g.text: Coach 6, the second evening, half past eight
Fourteen things to find. The booking system made four groups and the people made five.
the rack - one bag, four rows from its owner
seats 9 to 16 - the two sisters, four children
seats 17 to 24 - and one person alone
a bag, four rows from its owner
two sisters, four children between them
and one of the four paid full price
a coat over somebody asleep, and not theirs
Sam - seventeen, alone, and not lost
